Hi /v/heathenry ! I'm not sure if I'm allowed to introduce myself, but alright! I'm Sanvi, 24 from the Netherlands. I've been on my own spiritual path since birth, but I only realized "it existed" and was called heathenry/asatru when I was 17. I joined a (non-democratic) kindred back then, switched around, met people and am currently really active in a democratic thing-based kindred with gatherings every other month or so.

I think it's always important to see and learn from other heathens, so you won't end up in dogma's or running the same circles. It's also really nice to see how alive heathenry still is, and how many events and gatherings there are. I have contact with a bunch of different groups and practicioners from all over, but mostly in The Netherlands and Sweden. I really wish I was able to go to the International Asatru Camp (IASC), but couldn't make it due to other obligations.

Like I said, I'm active in The Netherlands, if anyone is around or visiting from abroad and would like to join my kindred at an event, that's possible :) We are looking to develop more international relationships with other kindreds so we can learn from our different approaches and knowledge on things.

Ofcourse, if anyone wants to contact me, feel free to send a PM or post a comment!
